notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.content:
Prologue Update Content:

[list]
[*] Bicycle physics and camera have been adjusted.
[*] View distance and quality have been improved. 
[*] Bugs in the Crypto app have been fixed.
[*] Economic balances have been refined.
[*] Fixed errors occurring during refueling.
[*] Coffee shop and other interactions have been made smoother.
[*] It is now not possible to make an offer worse than the last one in vehicle buying and selling.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Note
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you to everyone who plays the game and shares their thoughts, whether good or bad.[/h1]

As a solo developer, all of the feedback has had a great impact on helping me understand what's missing and what could have been done better. Every piece of feedback has been taken seriously and will continue to be.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/VnhZD2vNMs]If you have any complaints or suggestions, please join the Discord channel.[/url]

After one week since release, I wanted to share some key updates that have been made:

[list]
[*] As many players requested, you can now make deliveries with your car.
[*] The save problem with the time of day has been fixed.
[*] Issues with Coffee Shop upgrades have been fixed.
[*] Problems with listing and adding images to sale offers in the Used Car App have been fixed.
[*] Freeze problem with Sell & Buy meetings has been fixed.
[*] Lighting in the Car Modification Shop has been updated.
[/list]
